Subject: Next Steps to Complete Supplier Compliance Packet — Insurance Schedule & PO Kickoff

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the productive onboarding call this morning. To move EdgeFlow to an active PO and allow invoices to be routed, procurement needs the items below. We can keep the PO in conditional status until we have the documents, but final activation requires them.

Required from EdgeFlow (please reply to all):
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as Additional Insured.
  - Limits: Commercial General Liability $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate; Professional Liability (E&O) $1M if applicable.
  - Endorsement naming Redwood Inference, Inc., 1101 Market St., San Francisco, CA 94103 as additional insured; waiver of subrogation where permitted.
- Completed vendor onboarding form (I attached the PDF sample we referenced).
- W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax form.
- Subcontractor disclosure: list of any material subcontractors who will process Redwood data.

If you can provide a scanned COI and the W-9 by EOD Wednesday (4/21), we should be able to issue a PO within 24 business hours of receipt. If the endorsement requires your broker to complete a form, you can send a signed copy or use the DocuSign link I attached.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: onboarding_form_sample.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

High level ask: please confirm what you can provide today and a target time for outstanding items. Happy to jump on a quick call with Marissa and Karthik if that helps.

Best,

Hi Samir —

Thanks for sending the COI and W-9. The COI is a good start but procurement/legal require an endorsement that explicitly names Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured and includes a waiver of subrogation where allowed. The simplest path is for your broker to complete an endorsement using our standard wording — link below — and return a signed PDF. That will satisfy our Risk team.

Endorsement requirements (short):
- "Redwood Inference, Inc., its affiliates and their respective officers, directors, employees and agents" listed as Additional Insured.
- Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood on the GL policy where permitted by law.
- Policy effective dates that cover any work performed for Redwood.

Practical notes:
- Policy numbers: not required on the endorsement as long as it references the COI (our system ties them).
- Address: please include the company name and our HQ address (1101 Market St., San Francisco, CA 94103) on the endorsement — that helps our records but is not a blocking point if broker omits address in the immediate PDF.

DocuSign template: https://docusign.com/embedded/ABC-endorsement-req-DF9876
Endorsement example/template: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/templates/endorsement-template.pdf

Once we have the signed endorsement and final COI, we'll move the PO from conditional to active. Our team will provision a provisional PO number in the meantime: PO-IR-2027-DF9876 (this will be replaced with the final PO on activation; please include the provisional number on any preliminary invoices so AP can match records).

If you expect any delay beyond 48 hours, let us know and we'll note the hold in the vendor record.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
